cells.gaps: Nothing found since October 2023 says a Seychelles e-procurement system is procured, being built, piloted or in service; the vendor's requirements were still to be drafted in November 2026.
cells.note: SYC-001 is an AfDB loan whose reforms include e-procurement, and SYC-002 (November 2026) seeks an adviser to help draft the requirements for the e-GP vendor. Neither shows a system procured, built or piloted, so no rung is set.
